public.title: Partition Equal Subset Sum
public.description: Return whether values can be split into two disjoint groups with equal sums, using every value once. Empty groups are allowed. There are 0 to 100 positive integers, each at most 100.
hints: The target sum is half the total. Update reachable sums in descending order.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Descending updates prevent reusing the current number. The dynamic program costs O(n times total sum) time.
